name: orbit-round-check
description: Headless checks for Orbit's page scripts (round layout, circular reader, link focus, search results), Orbit for Claude's chat script, and unit tests for the GeckoView extension.

scripts.check: node check.mjs && node reader-check.mjs && node links-check.mjs && node serp-check.mjs --no-live && node claude-check.mjs && node --test extension.test.mjs
